settings.label: App ID
settings.help: Of a Meta app with Facebook Login. Empty = SIMULATED demonstration mode.

authMethod.name: Facebook
authMethod.description: Federated sign-in with a Facebook account (OAuth2 manual flow: state, token exchange and a debug_token check that the token belongs to this app - Facebook Login is not OIDC). The account must be explicitly linked to a local account.

setupGuide.intro: Everything happens on this screen. Leave the App ID empty to try the simulated demo mode (screen marked DEMO, fictional accounts).
steps: Open the {console} > My Apps > Create app, and add the Facebook Login product. See the {docs}.
Under Facebook Login > Settings > Valid OAuth Redirect URIs, paste exactly:
Copy the App ID and App secret (Settings > Basic) into the fields below, then Save. Keep the app in Live mode for real sign-ins.
Each person then links their Facebook account from their Profile page (Linked sign-in providers). No automatic linking by e-mail.
